Exchanges.Text:
Good morning, Gate team-b.

Our sprint goal is: Customers can pay by card and failed payments retry automatically, and there are 5 days left in the sprint.

Daniel, is story 3 done, is story 4 done, and is task 19 done, and have you been able to help Maya Lin with bug 12 on Sandbox gateway timeouts on retry?

Also, what did you finish, what’s next, and is anything blocking you?
Yesterday I finished card tokenisation and shipped the payment status API version two. Today I'm adding idempotency keys to payment requests. Nothing blocking me.

Daniel, I’ve noted your commitment: yesterday you finished card tokenisation and shipped the payment status API version two, and today you’re adding idempotency keys to payment requests, with nothing blocking you.

Task 19, Prepare reconciliation report for audit, is past its due date. What is the new date?
The reconciliation report is at risk. I'll start it right after the idempotency keys, and flag it if it slips.

Daniel, I’ve noted that the reconciliation report is at risk, you’ll start it right after the idempotency keys, and you’ll flag it if it slips.

Daniel, story 3, Customer payment plan summary page, has been Active for 5 days. Still on track?
Yes, it's on track. I'll pick the summary page back up as soon as the idempotency keys are in.
Who can help unblock this while you’re waiting to pick the summary page back up after the idempotency keys are in?
Yes, that's right. That's everything from me.

Thanks, Daniel.

Maya, is bug 12 done, and is story 5 done? What did you finish, what’s next, and is anything blocking you?

Yesterday I reviewed the settlement schema. Today I'm continuing the settlement file validation. I'm blocked on bug 12. The sandbox gateway keeps timing out, and I need access to the platform team's staging gateway.
Sorry to jump in, Maya, but we hit the same gateway timeouts last sprint when we upgraded the TLS library, and it took us days to track down.
Right, I think the root cause was the connection pool settings, so we should compare the gateway configuration between sandbox and staging, and also check whether the sandbox certificate was rotated.
Let's take that offline and I will add it to the parking lot, and Maya please carry on.
That's everything from me.
Maya, for bug 12 with the sandbox gateway timeouts and needing access to the platform team’s staging gateway, who can help unblock this?
Daniel can help. He fixed the same gateway timeouts last sprint, so I'll pair with him on the staging access today.

Maya, I’ve noted your commitment: I’ll pair with him on the staging access today.

Maya, story 5, Update PCI scan exceptions, has been Active for 5 days. Still on track?
The PCI scan exceptions are waiting on the security review. I'll chase them today.
Maya, I’ve noted the blocker that the PCI scan exceptions are waiting on the security review and your commitment to chase them today, and this blocker will be flagged for follow-up.

Thanks, Maya.

Admin, is task 14 done, and is story 1 done as you committed earlier? What did you finish, what’s next, and is anything blocking you?
Yesterday, I finished the refund API tests.
Today I'm still working on the payment retry story.
No blockers.

Admin, I’ve noted your update: yesterday you finished the refund API tests, today you’re working on the payment retry story, and there are no blockers.

Task 14, Write retry load test, is past its due date. What is the new date?
It slept because the sandbox was down.
I should finish it tomorrow.
For the sandbox outage that caused this slip, who can help unblock it so you can finish tomorrow?
Maya can help.
She's already chasing the platform team about the sandbox, so I'll sync with her after the stand-up.
Admin, I’ve noted the blocker: waiting on the sandbox from the platform team, and it will be flagged for follow-up.
Yes, that's right.
That's everything from me.

Blockers were raised: the summary page will resume after idempotency keys, Maya is blocked on bug 12 with sandbox gateway timeouts and needs staging access, the PCI scan exceptions are waiting on security review, and the sandbox outage and platform-team sandbox access are affecting work. A side discussion between Daniel Park and Admin about gateway timeouts is parked for offline. Task 15 (stale) was not covered, and its owners will get a follow-up about it. Follow-ups, including any for absences or non-responses, are coming in Teams, and thank you everyone.
